title: 我的放学时光
focus: 一般现在时：I 与 she/he
rule: 说经常发生的事情，用一般现在时。主语是 he 或 she 时，很多动词要加 s。
example: I read after school. Mia reads after school.

words.sentence: I have a snack after school.

allWords.sentence: I have a snack after school.

story: Mia arrives home at four. She has an apple and some milk. Then she practises the piano for ten minutes. Her brother Ben collects stones in the garden. Before dinner, Mia tidies her desk and Ben puts his stones in a box. They both have time to rest.

questions.why: I have a snack after school.
Mia相当于she；一般现在时的tidy要变成tidies。

check: 介绍家人时检查动词形式
